description.en: Save a DSH session as a single .dsproj project file with Word-style save, save-as and autosave, then open it on another machine to continue the conversation. Native file dialogs on Windows, macOS and Linux.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，像 Word 一样保存、另存和自动保存，换台机器打开就能接着聊。Windows / macOS / Linux 均有原生文件对话框。
